summary: Risk-off arrived in size. The Nasdaq ran to a fresh overnight high near 27,838, then sold off the whole cash session to close at the lows, down 2.2 percent, losing its hourly trend stop. The S and P mirrored it, down 2.0 percent and also below its stop, so this was broad de-risking. Gold fell with stocks (down 1.8 percent), a cash-raising tell, while crude firmed 0.4 percent and reclaimed its own trend line. VIX jumped 16 percent to 28.6. Theme of the day: Stocks and gold sold together.

risk.note: VIX 28.6 is in the 25 to 30 DEFENSIVE band and the trend is down across equities and gold. Keep size light, respect the downtrend, no new longs into a confirmed markdown, let volatility compress before adding. Week ahead: November flash PMIs (S&P Global manufacturing and services) are the main scheduled item into Friday; nothing of the earlier-week magnitude.

psychology: The trap today was the overnight high. Price pushed to a new high before the open, and the pull was to buy that strength and then average down as it fell. Days like this punish anchoring to the high and reward accepting the trend. If you caught yourself adding to a long on the way down because it had to bounce, that is the tell to size down.

Busy open: if the first 30 minutes cover at least the number shown, expect a wider day than normal. Give trades more room.

Close at the top or bottom: do not count on follow-through at the next open.
